svg.title: Two routes through the research chapters
svg.desc: Chapter 10 defines the research question and specification; Chapters 11 and 12 supply literature and data. The flow branches into saved-code analysis in Chapters 13–15 and research using LLM outputs in Chapters 16–17. Chapter 17 covers running or adapting LLMs when needed. The routes can be combined and rejoin for writing in Chapter 18 and handoff in Chapter 19. Feedback from evidence, data, checks, and writing returns to earlier work.
svg.text: Approve scientific revisions and record their reasons
